notes: Conjecture 2 true: no odd n>3 has phi(m)>=phi(n) for all m>n (replace a prime p>=5 by 2s with s a Bertrand prime, or 3^k by 4*3^(k-1)), so members other than 1 and 3 are even (Lean). Conjecture 3 false: every member above 714 is divisible by 30 (replace a prime p by q*s, q in {3,5}, s prime in (p/q,(p-1)/(q-1)); finite exceptions handled by explicit moves; members below 3.19e7 by sieve). Conjecture 1 (infinitely many multiples of each member) not settled; only one multiple of 900 below 3.19e7. Outside Lean: the divisibility by 3 and 5 of members above 714 (Nagura for p>=10^4, Python move certificates moves.py and cert5.py, C sieve to 2e8 with the Rosser-Schoenfeld bound).
